qualification.title: LA28 qualification pathway under revision
qualification.summary: UCI confirmed that the 2026 Urban Cycling World Championships in Riyadh (3–7 November) will not take place. On 19 October it said the LA28 BMX Freestyle pathway is being revised with the IOC, with details expected in November. This does not cancel the 2027 Worlds in France.
qualification.rankingNote: General UCI world-ranking points and Olympic qualification points are different. The published Q-Series entry document references the 7 December 2027 ranking, but the revised pathway must be checked before relying on it for Olympic qualification.

sources.title: Published Q-Series entry rules — subject to revision

announcements.title: 2026 Worlds cancelled; LA28 pathway being revised
announcements.summary: UCI confirmed that the Riyadh 2026 Worlds will not take place. The planned initial BMX Freestyle Olympic qualification opportunity is affected; revised pathway details are due in November.
announcements.impactGermany: German riders should not plan points from Riyadh 2026. Continue checking German Cycling selection and the revised UCI pathway; 2027 UCI ranking events are not automatically direct Olympic qualification events.
announcements.impactAustralia: Australian riders should not plan points from Riyadh 2026. Continue checking AusCycling selection and the revised UCI pathway; 2027 UCI ranking events are not automatically direct Olympic qualification events.

deadlines.label: Revised qualification pathway expected in November 2026; UCI has not given an exact release day.

reviewCandidates.title: Official BMX Freestyle / LA28 document
reviewCandidates.reason: New official source found; verify its meaning before publishing any qualification claim or notification.
reviewCandidates.reviewNote: Read the UCI memorandum dated 29 September 2026 in full. Its 1 January 2027 amendment concerns judging the final trick when run time expires (article 6bis.6.031). It does not introduce or revise LA28 qualification quotas, ranking dates, entry deadlines or points eligibility.

reviewCandidates.title: Official BMX Freestyle / LA28 document

reviewCandidates.reviewNote: Read the historical memorandum dated 6 October 2025, effective 1 January 2026. Its entry, format and world-ranking rules are already part of the baseline. National and continental ranking restrictions are reflected in the schedule. This is not a new LA28 qualification announcement.
